title: LmdbBlockStore and LmdbStore are near-identical; trait method name asymmetry is the root cause
description: reader/src/post/lmdb_store.rs and transit/src/peering/lmdb_store.rs have identical logic but implement IpfsBlockStore (put_raw_block/get_raw_block) and IpfsStore (put_raw/get_raw) respectively. The two traits describe the same concept (raw block storage) with different method names. Either unify the two traits into one in stoa-core and have both crates import it, or at minimum rename methods to be consistent. As-is, a fix to the LMDB write path must be made in two places.
notes: Scope note: renaming put_raw_block/get_raw_block across IpfsBlockStore would touch 30+ call sites in mail, reader, integration-tests plus the trait definition. The get semantics also differ (Option vs hard error), so full unification needs a design decision first. Deferring to a standalone refactor epic.
